minor.issue: founding-a4.png last-ink-y=1689 vs review target >=1700 (11px short). The mission-line footer in render_founding() is built as `_draw_mission_footer(c, slogan_y + 36)` where slogan_y stacks upward from the URL pill (render_flyer_previews.py:460). Because the V3 layout shrank the QR (500→460) and inserted the benefits area, the pill now sits ~25px higher on the canvas than it did in iter_114 (which measured 1714). The mission line follows the pill upward. Fix: mirror the render_download() pattern — anchor from the bottom, e.g., `mission_y = PAGE_H - 62; slogan_y = mission_y - 36; caption_y = slogan_y - 28; pill_y = caption_y - 8 - pill_h` (invert the current forward-stacking). This propagates to founding-a4-hires (scale=2 master) and founding-a3-hires automatically.

action_items: In /app/backend/scripts/render_flyer_previews.py::render_founding() (around lines 440-460), replace the forward-stacked footer geometry (pill_y → caption_y → slogan_y → mission_y = slogan_y+36) with a bottom-anchored one: set `mission_y = PAGE_H - 62` first (same constant render_download uses), then derive `slogan_y = mission_y - 36`, `caption_y = slogan_y - 28`, and place the URL pill above caption_y with the existing 8-px gap. Target: founding-a4.png last-ink-y >= 1700.
Re-run `python /app/backend/scripts/render_flyer_previews.py` after edits, then re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_flyer_v2_deliverables.py -v` — expect 40/40 pass.

OPTIONAL (repeat of iter_114 recommendation): add a post-render assertion inside each renderer that scans for the last non-white row and confirms it >= (PAGE_H - reserved_footer_px). Two full iterations of layout drift on the same footer would have been caught immediately by such a guard.
critical_code_review_comments: render_flyer_previews.py::render_founding still uses forward-stacked footer positioning while render_download was migrated to bottom-anchored positioning in iter_115. This is the SAME anti-pattern that caused the 4-px-short bug fixed in iter_114 for download. Consistency between the two renderers matters — any time content above the footer resizes (QR, ribbon, benefits area), the founding footer drifts unpredictably.

The magic number `slogan_y + 36` at line 460 has no linkage to canvas height. Whenever a design tweak lands anywhere above it, the mission line silently moves. Convert to `mission_y = PAGE_H - N` in both renderers.

rca_of_issue: RCA for the 3 remaining failures (all one root cause): In render_founding() the footer chain is built forward-stacked from the URL pill: `caption_y = pill_y + pill_h + 8; slogan_y = caption_y + 28; _draw_mission_footer(c, slogan_y + 36)`. When the V3 layout inserted the benefits area between the ribbon and the QR (and shrank the QR from 500→460), everything above the pill moved up by ~25px, dragging the pill (and consequently the mission footer) up with it. Iter_114 measured founding-a4 last-ink-y=1714; iter_115 measures 1689 (-25px). Meanwhile render_download() was migrated to a bottom-anchored footer (`mission_y = PAGE_H - 62`) in iter_115 and now hits 1722 comfortably. Fix render_founding to use the same bottom-anchored pattern and the 11-px shortfall disappears. Reproduction: `python3 -c "from PIL import Image; im=Image.open('/app/website/public/flyer-mockups/founding-a4.png').convert('RGB'); px=im.load(); print(max(y for y in range(1754) for x in range(1240) if any(v<235 for v in px[x,y])))"` prints 1689.
